title: Code for "Modeling sequential cognitive states via population-level cortical dynamics"
description: Code that produces every computed figure and number of the paper Modeling sequential cognitive states via population-level cortical dynamics by M. Virginia Bolelli, Luca Greco and Dario Prandi: the heteroclinic cycle of Figure 2.1(b), the trained neural fields of Section 5 with their checks, and the cyclic-inhibition example of the Supplementary Material.
